hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Store available drivers by their identifier and location, and track busy rides in an active status dictionary.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: For each ride request, calculate the Manhattan distance to all free drivers and select the closest one.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Break distance ties by choosing the driver with the numerically smallest identifier.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Requesting a ride takes O(d) to scan through available drivers, while add and complete take O(1) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A brute force approach would exceed time limits by redundantly reprocessing states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Balances linear traversal with auxiliary tracking structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects an optimal linear or logarithmic solution with edge-case handling.
